properties.name: note
properties.value: NOT a product component. A deliberately old, known-vulnerable OpenSSL pin used only to prove Grype's CPE matcher is live in CI. If a scan of this finds zero CVEs, CPE matching is broken and a clean result for the real product SBOM would be meaningless -- so the workflow fails on a zero canary. Never ship or reference this file outside the security-scan self-test.
